description: This file defines sampling strategies and interfaces for the OpenTelemetry SDK's tracing component, including various sampler implementations and configuration options.

classes.name: traceIDRatioSampler
classes.description: Sampler implementation that makes sampling decisions based on trace ID ratio.

classes.name: alwaysOnSampler
classes.description: Sampler that always samples all traces.

classes.name: alwaysOffSampler
classes.description: Sampler that never samples any traces.

classes.name: parentBased
classes.description: Composite sampler that bases decision on parent span context.

classes.name: alwaysRecord
classes.description: Decorator sampler that converts Drop decisions into RecordOnly to ensure all spans are processed.

methods.name: ShouldSample
methods.description: Method to decide whether to sample a span based on provided parameters.

methods.name: Description
methods.description: Returns a string description of the sampler.

methods.name: TraceIDRatioBased
methods.description: Factory function to create a trace ID ratio-based sampler.

methods.name: AlwaysSample
methods.description: Factory function to create a sampler that samples all traces.

methods.name: NeverSample
methods.description: Factory function to create a sampler that samples no traces.

methods.name: ParentBased
methods.description: Factory function to create a parent-based sampler with configuration options.

methods.name: AlwaysRecord
methods.description: Factory function to create a sampler that records all spans, even dropped ones.
